author: mfhansen
title: PyTorch Models tests fail with pyarrow/NumPy ABI mismatch (ImportError: pyarrow requires NumPy 2.0)
signature: pyarrow requires numpy 2.0 or newer but older numpy installed causing importerror in datasets/pyarrow dependency chain|Dependencies

failed_jobs.name: PyTorch Models tests / PyTorch Models tests
failed_jobs.symptom: 7 HF transformers model-hub tests fail during model loading: ImportError pyarrow requires NumPy 2.0 or newer, found 1.26.4

failed_jobs.name: ci/gha_overall_status
failed_jobs.symptom: Aggregate status check fails because the PyTorch Models tests job failed

key_errors:
File "/venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages/datasets/arrow_dataset.py", line 60, in <module>
    import pyarrow as pa
  File "/venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages/pyarrow/__init__.py", line 59, in <module>
    from pyarrow.lib import (BuildInfo, CppBuildInfo, RuntimeInfo, set_timezone_db_path,
  File "pyarrow/lib.pyx", line 42, in init pyarrow.lib
ImportError: pyarrow requires NumPy 2.0 or newer, found 1.26.4
root_cause: The 'PyTorch Models Tests Not Timm or Torchvision' step pip-installs a set of HF transformer test requirements that resolve to a pyarrow build requiring NumPy>=2.0, while the environment/venv still has an older NumPy 1.26.4 pinned (likely by another dependency in the same requirements set or the pre-existing venv). When test_hf_transformers.py imports `datasets`, which imports `pyarrow`, the native pyarrow.lib extension raises ImportError because of the ABI/version mismatch. The PR under test (#39512) only modifies a benchmarks CSV doc file and is unrelated to this failure; the same signature has recurred 3 times in the last ~36 hours on unrelated PRs, confirming an environment/dependency-pinning issue rather than a PR-introduced regression.
reproduction_steps:
1. Build/obtain the openvino wheels as in job_pytorch_models_tests.yml.
2. Install install/tests/model_hub_tests/pytorch requirements as done in CI (pip install -r requirements.txt for model_hub_tests/pytorch).
3. Run: python3 -m pytest install/tests/model_hub_tests/pytorch -m precommit -k "not (TestTimmConvertModel or TestTorchHubConvertModel or TestEdsrConvertModel or TestLLMModel or TestDetectron2ConvertModel or TestTorchbenchmarkConvertModel)" -v
4. Observe ImportError: pyarrow requires NumPy 2.0 or newer, found 1.26.4 when test_hf_transformers.py imports `datasets`.
recommended_actions: Pin a pyarrow version compatible with NumPy 1.26.x (e.g. pyarrow<18) in the model_hub_tests/pytorch requirements, OR upgrade numpy to >=2.0 in that same requirements file so pyarrow's ABI matches.
Audit src/bindings/python and model_hub_tests requirements files for conflicting numpy/pyarrow pins and align them.
Add a CI smoke check that imports `datasets`/`pyarrow` right after dependency installation to fail fast with a clear message instead of deep inside a multiprocessing worker.
prevention_strategies: Pin compatible numpy/pyarrow versions together in all requirements files used by PyTorch model-hub tests, and add a pip check/dependency-resolution step (e.g., `pip check`) after installing test requirements to catch ABI-incompatible combinations before running tests.
historical_context: This is the 3rd occurrence of the same pyarrow/NumPy ABI mismatch recorded in the pattern database within roughly the last 36 hours (runs 41939333537, 41968975085, 42062435152), all against PR #39512's merge-queue runs, none caused by the PR's own (docs-only) changes.
